about.title: About us
about.body:
Agrobudservice is a leading company with many years of experience in sand and limestone extraction and with modern technological solutions in mineral powder production in western Ukraine.

Agrobudservice is part of ONUR GROUP in the Mining & Quarrying sector. ONUR GROUP is an international group founded in 1981. It consists of more than 40 companies operating in 13 sectors of the economy. Its main field of activity is the design and construction of roads, bridges, tunnels, dams, airports, tram lines and other infrastructure facilities.

capacity.title: tonnes per year of production capacity
capacity.body: With the ability to produce more than 1 million tonnes of products annually, our company ensures a stable and timely supply of materials. Regardless of the volume or complexity of the task, we are ready to respond to market challenges and fulfil large-scale orders within short deadlines, helping our partners avoid delays and optimise their costs.

fleet.title: A modern equipment fleet
fleet.body: Throughout the entire production process we use only the latest technologies and equipment from well-known global brands: Ersel for mineral powder production, Metso mobile crushers, Powerscreen mobile screens, Ozfen stationary screens, Hidromek, Sumitomo and Komatsu excavators, Volvo dump trucks, Mercedes and MAN. This allows us to guarantee the quality of our products, a wide choice, compliance with the most demanding standards and delivery in large volumes.

partnership.title: partnerships built on trust
partnership.body: A sense of partnership and mutual growth is central to our approach, because we deeply believe in the importance of every project and its impact on the future. Our main motivation is our clients’ successful results and our team’s ability to contribute to them. A high level of service and attention to detail have earned us the trust of more than 100 leading companies across various industries.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.body: The first step is a consultation with our manager. They will help you decide on the type of material you need and its volume. The manager will also give you all the necessary information about the characteristics of the materials and the terms of delivery. Do you need quality certificates or other documentation? A company representative will provide them on request.

order.title: Placing an order
order.body: After the consultation you can place an order. To do so you need to give us information about the type of material, its volume and the delivery location. We do not set a minimum order volume, while our production capacity is able to meet the needs of large-scale projects. We work with clients from all over Ukraine, as we can promptly ship large volumes of material.

analysis.title: Technical analysis
analysis.body: If needed, you can send your own technologists to run tests on the fraction, moisture content and other characteristics of the raw material. It is also possible to send a free sample batch of our products to potential clients: 5–10 kg of sand, limestone or mineral powder.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: We give clients the option of deferred payment depending on the order volume and individual arrangements.

delivery.title: Self-pickup and delivery
delivery.body:
We have our own vehicle fleet that ensures timely delivery of materials. Within the Lviv region we can arrange one-off or regular delivery of around 600 tonnes of product per day. To keep the product fresh and to avoid overloading your warehouses, we are ready to deliver materials on a regular schedule.

Self-pickup directly from the extraction and production site is also available: Agrobudservice is located 1.7 km from the M06 Kyiv–Chop motorway, so it is convenient to drive up in your own transport.

Delivery is carried out throughout Ukraine within the deadlines agreed with you, promptly and without queues. The Mykolaiv-Dnistrovskyi railway station is located near the production site, which makes it possible to ship large-scale orders by rail.

buildingMaterials.title: Building materials production
buildingMaterials.body: Agrobudservice products are in demand among producers of cement, concrete, asphalt concrete mixes, hydrated lime and dry construction mixes such as Alba, Ferozit, Ceresit and others.

construction.title: Construction and engineering work
construction.body: Our materials are used by companies specialising in road construction, property development and landscape design. For example, screened and unscreened sand, sand by-products or limestone can be used for backfilling trenches, preparing surfaces for paving, and forming layers under foundations and road surfaces. Sandstone is used in restoration work.

agriculture.title: Agricultural sector
agriculture.body: Limestone is widely used in agriculture. First, it serves as a mineral fertiliser that is effective at deacidifying soil and makes it more favourable for plant growth. Second, limestone used as a feed additive for cows, pigs and poultry supports nutrient absorption and improves animal productivity. Third, limestone is an excellent material for road bedding, making sites easier for machinery to reach.

metallurgy.title: Metallurgy
metallurgy.body: Limestone from Agrobudservice is used in the metallurgical sector as a flux. It helps remove impurities from ore and activates a number of important processes: slag formation, lowering the melting point of ore and promoting its oxidation, protecting the furnace lining and improving steel quality.

glass.title: Glass production
glass.body: Adding limestone to the glass production process (to introduce calcium oxide) not only provides the required chemical properties of the finished product but also gives it chemical resistance. This is especially important for the long and reliable service life of glass products in various operating conditions.

private.title: For private households
private.body: Agrobudservice extracts and supplies materials for the needs of private households. The range includes screened and unscreened sand, sand by-products, sandstone and limestone in various fractions. In the private sector our products can be useful for a variety of jobs: soil stabilisation, laying paving, plastering walls, pouring screeds, landscaping a garden plot and more. We do not set a minimum order quantity.

career.metaDescription: Careers at Agrobudservice ⭐️ Decent working conditions ✔ Opportunities for professional growth ☎ +38 067 311 80 44
career.title: Careers
career.intro:
Agrobudservice is more than 50 professionals thanks to whom we can guarantee product quality, a high level of service, attentiveness to client needs and resilience to new market challenges.

We value and support everyone on our team, creating decent working conditions and opportunities for professional growth, and we invest in developing those who join the company without experience. We pay considerable attention to building a corporate culture with shared values and an environment of mutual respect and support.

Agrobudservice is open to new specialists joining the team. Together we will shape the future of the industry.

If you have any questions or would like to share your ideas, please get in touch. We are always ready to listen and to work together.
